title: CircuitKIT circuit · post_inject
notes: Node scores from CircuitKIT (eap-ig, task tofu_forget_fact). 'In circuit' = CircuitKIT's top-fraction safety_units. Edges are derived (layer-adjacent), not measured. Task tofu_forget_fact: 32 forget questions, each paired with a length-matched retain question (mean |token length diff| 0.125); target = first answer token, metric = logit difference (forget answer token minus retain answer token). Experimental Tiny Aya support in CircuitKIT.
provenance_note: Node scores are measured by CircuitKIT; the 'in circuit' set is a display threshold and the edges are derived (layer-adjacent), not measured.
